title: Agent Scorecards
heading: Create a New Agent Scorecard
text: Creating an agent scorecard involves the following three sections: 1. Select + New Agent Score Card .

title: Agent Scorecards
heading: Configure General Settings
text: 2. By default, the system displays the Settings tab. 3. Enter a Name for the scorecard. 4. Enter a short optional Description . 5. Select the Call Direction to define applicable interactions— Inbound , Outbound , or Both . 6. Select the required Languages from the drop-down to load the associated evaluation metrics and attributes. 7. Select a Not Applicable Scoring Treatment : - Exclude from Score (default): Removes a Not Applicable metric's weightage from both the numerator and denominator when the system aggregates metric results into Agent Attribute and Scorecard scores. - Award Full Weightage : Adds a Not Applicable metric's weightage to both the numerator and denominator, so the metric contributes full marks to the Agent Attribute and Scorecard scores while its displayed outcome stays Not Applicable. This setting uses a separate configuration from the Not Applicable Scoring Treatment configured on the evaluation form. It doesn't inherit the evaluation form's setting and applies only to future evaluations. When the two settings use different values, the scorecard score can differ from the corresponding evaluation form score. 7. Turn on to Set the minimum duration required to complete evaluations . 8. Enter a threshold value in minutes ( MIN ) and seconds ( SEC ). 9. Set the minimum Pass Score required for agents. 10. Select Next . At least one scorecard you must set as the default. The first scorecard you create becomes the default automatically. Before removing the default setting from a scorecard, assign another scorecard as the default.

title: Agent Scorecards
heading: Configure Agent Attributes
text: Select and configure attributes that define agent performance scoring. 1. Search for the relevant agent attributes name. 1. Select Agent Attributes to add them to the scorecard. Only attributes matching the selected languages are shown. Each attribute contributes proportionally to the final score. The Next button is enabled only when total weightage equals 100%. 1. Select Add Agent Attributes . 1. Assign a Weightage to each selected attribute. 1. Select Next . Only attributes matching the selected languages are shown. Each attribute contributes proportionally to the final score. The Next button is enabled only when total weightage equals 100%.

title: Agent Scorecards
heading: Configure Assignments
text: Assign the scorecard to agents and agent groups. 1. Search and select agents or agent groups, and configure contact direction-based assignment. 1. Select Add Agents and Add Groups to include them in the scorecard. 1. Select Create to create the Agent Scorecard with the selected agent attributes and assigned agents and agent groups. Toggle the Scorecard Status to Active to begin agent-level scoring.

title: Agent Scorecards
heading: Agent Scorecard Elements
text: The Agent Scorecards elements list displays the following columns for each scorecard: - Name : Name of the agent scorecard. - Agent Attribute : List of performance attributes assigned to the scorecard. - Assignee : Agents or agent groups assigned to the scorecard. - Created By : Name of the user who created the scorecard. - Pass Score : Minimum score threshold required for an agent to pass. - Status : Indicates whether the scorecard is Active or Inactive. - Search : Search for agent scorecards by name. --- Not Applicable Scoring Treatment The scorecard-level Not Applicable Scoring Treatment determines how Not Applicable metric outcomes contribute to Agent Attribute and overall Scorecard scores. The system applies this setting across the Agent Leaderboard, Agent Dashboard, and agent-specific dashboards. It doesn't inherit the Not Applicable Scoring Treatment configured on the evaluation form. Treatment Effect on Agent Attribute and Scorecard Scores --- --- Exclude from Score (default) Excludes the Not Applicable metric's weight from the score calculation by removing it from both the numerator and denominator. Award Full Weightage Includes the Not Applicable metric's weight as full credit by adding it to both the numerator and denominator. The metric remains marked as Not Applicable . A change to this setting doesn't retroactively rescore conversations evaluated. It applies only to metric contributions from conversations scored after the change. Not Applicable scoring is configured independently for evaluation forms and scorecards. Different settings can result in different scores for the same interaction. --- How Minimum Duration Threshold Works The minimum duration threshold determines the shortest interaction that qualifies for AutoQA scoring. Contact Duration Status Assigned Result -------------------------- -------------------- ----------------------------------------- Meets or exceeds threshold — Evaluated normally. Falls below threshold Below Threshold Excluded

heading: Edit an Agent Scorecard
text: 1. Select the vertical ellipse (⋮) on any existing scorecard. 2. Select Edit . 3. Update the Settings , including Not Applicable Scoring Treatment , Agent Attributes , or Assignments , as needed. 4. Select Update to save. --- Delete an Agent Scorecard To delete an agent scorecard: 1. Select the vertical ellipsis (⋮) for the scorecard you want to delete. 2. Remove any unassigned attributes. Select the vertical ellipsis ( ⋮ ) for the current default scorecard. 3. Select Delete . If you attempt to delete the default scorecard without assigning another scorecard as the default, the system displays a warning dialog. Delete an Agent Scorecard 1. Select the vertical ellipse (⋮) on any existing scorecard. 1. Delete attributes only if they're unassigned; otherwise, remove associated scorecards first. 1. Select Delete to permanently remove the selected agent scorecard. Delete Agent Scorecard When you delete an agent scorecard, you permanently lose all data linked to that scorecard, and you can't recover it. Delete Default Scorecard You can't delete the default scorecard directly. Before deleting any default scorecard, you must assign another scorecard as the default before deleting the current scorecard. Otherwise, the system displays a warning dialog.

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
text: This extracts valuable insights from customer interactions across various communication channels. It captures information from spoken and written conversations, matches it with structured metadata about the interaction, and analyzes emotions and sentiments to understand customers' needs, opinions, and expectations. All post-interaction analytics from Contact Center AI interactions are reflected here. This helps you make app-level changes to Conversation Intelligence . It includes following three sections: - Conversation Intelligence - Quality AI General Settings - Language Settings ---

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
heading: Access Conversation Intelligence
text: Navigate to Quality AI Configure Settings Conversation Intelligence . ---

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
heading: Enable Conversation Intelligence
text: 1. Enable the Conversation Intelligence Dashboard toggle. 1. Configure script adherence settings as required. Role permissions in Settings are defined by Admin based on agent roles. ---

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
heading: Interaction Level Resolution Detection Methods
text: This setting defines how the system determines contact-level resolution across conversations. Select the method that aligns with your quality standards and reporting needs. The system controls resolution calculation, while the Taxonomy Builder defines success and failure criteria for topics. ---

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
heading: Method 1: Topic-Based Resolution (Strict)
text: The system evaluates resolution using AND logic across all L3 topics in a conversation. A contact is marked resolved only when every topic is successfully resolved. Use when: - You want strict resolution evaluation across all topics - You want to prevent minor mentions from affecting resolution metrics - You want structured control via Taxonomy Builder For example, if a payment issue is resolved but a rewards question isn't, the contact is still marked as resolved only if all L3 topics are resolved. Configuration: 1. Go to Settings Conversation Intelligence 2. Select Topic-Based Resolution (Strict) 3. Select Save No additional configuration is required in Taxonomy Builder. ---

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
heading: Method 2: Overall Contact Level Resolution (Holistic Assessment)
text: The system uses an LLM-based evaluation to determine whether the primary reason for contact is resolved, even if minor issues remain unresolved. Use when: - You want outcome-based evaluation of primary intent - You want flexibility in handling secondary issues - You want LLM-driven resolution assessment For example, if a payment issue is resolved but a rewards question remains unresolved, the contact is still marked as resolved if the primary issue is addressed. Configuration: 1. Go to Settings Conversation Intelligence 2. Select Overall Contact Level Resolution (Holistic Assessment) 3. Select Save 4. Go to Quality AI Configure Taxonomy Builder 5. Open the Resolution tab 6. Configure Successful resolution description, Unsuccessful resolution description, and Overall resolution description and save configuration. ---

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
heading: Impact of Changing Resolution Method
text: Changing the resolution method affects: - All taxonomies in the organization - All queues and agents - Historical data interpretation - Real-time dashboards and reports - Agent performance metrics - QA workflows ---

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
heading: Settings (Application Level)
text: - Defines global resolution detection method - Applies across the entire organization - Requires admin permissions - Takes effect immediately system-wide

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings
heading: Taxonomy Builder (Taxonomy Level)
text: - Defines topic structure and classification - Configures topic-level resolution criteria (L3 only) - Manages resolution descriptions (when enabled) - Supports version-controlled updates ---

title: Conversation Intelligence Settings

title: Conversation Sources
text: Conversation Sources define the systems from which Quality AI ingests and processes conversations for AutoQA and Conversation Intelligence . Quality AI supports both Human Agent and AI Agent conversation sources. The Automation AI conversation source enables Quality AI to process conversations from Automation AI Experience Flows. When enabled, AutoQA evaluates AI Agent conversations using evaluation forms assigned to Experience Flows, while Conversation Intelligence analyzes conversations for sentiment, topics, and intents. Agent AI ingests conversations handled by AI-assisted human agents through supported external CCaaS or CRM agent desktop applications when the required conversation metadata is available. The Conversation Sources page helps you: - Enable or disable conversation sources. - Configure and manage voice and chat queues. - View queue details, including queue name, queue ID, system-generated ID, and assigned agents. - Add or edit queues. - Assign agents to Agent AI and Quality AI Express queues through the UI. - View queue details, including queue name, queue ID, system-generated queue ID, and assigned agents. - Configure whether Agent AI processes conversations when the AgentAI widget is turned off. This centralized configuration helps manage conversation ingestion and queue configuration while ensuring the metadata required for conversation processing is available.
